metadata.scenario: A customer calls to follow up on the processing of their last payment. Category: Follow-up.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Susan Garcia. I'm calling to follow up on the processing of my father's last payment. Hi Susan, thank you for calling. Can I have your father's name, please? Yes, it's John Garcia. Great, let me pull up his account. One moment please. Sure, take your time. Thank you for your patience, Susan. I see here that the payment was processed last week. Oh, that’s good to hear, but I haven’t received any confirmation yet. I understand. Let me check if we can send out a confirmation email. What email should I send that to? Please send it to susangarcia@email.com. Got it! I’ll send that confirmation to you right away. Thank you. Also, I was wondering about some additional services for my father. Absolutely! What services are you considering? He's been diagnosed with COPD, and I think he might need respiratory care and assistance with breathing treatments. We can definitely help with that. Our skilled nursing team offers respiratory care, which includes breathing treatments. That sounds perfect! Can you provide me with more details on that? Sure! Skilled nursing care is priced between $95 to $125 per visit, lasting 1 to 2 hours. That’s reasonable. How often would you recommend those visits? It typically depends on the patient’s needs, but starting with 2-3 visits a week is common. Okay, I’ll think about that. Can you also provide me with a quote based on those visits? Absolutely, I can have Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, reach out to you with a quote. That would be great. When can I expect her to contact me? Lisa is available Monday through Saturday. She should contact you by tomorrow. Perfect, I appreciate your help with this. You're welcome! Just to recap, I’ll send the payment confirmation and Lisa will reach out with the quote. Yes, that sounds good. Thank you, Margaret! Thank you for calling, Susan. Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
